answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks 50 POA in escrow, earning it back only after building a thread of distinct work no script can fake. Every job stamps the thread with an umber pigment mark, proof of real effort. Forging 1,000 identities locks 50,000 POA and needs 1,000 histories, against a 2,000 POA pool — a sure loss. An honest agent pays once, builds one thread, and unlocks its escrow plus its full share.
